summary: 74-year-old Fort Collins man suffered a cardiac emergency while snowshoeing near Mills Lake; his friends contacted park rangers by cell phone and began CPR but were unable to revive him; he was pronounced dead around 1 p.m.; park staff assisted by Larimer County Search and Rescue recovered his body and transferred it to the Larimer County Coroner.
location: Mills Lake, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: NPS Rocky Mountain National Park rangers; Larimer County Search and Rescue
